manual:
**Game plan:** flood cheap EARTH beaters via recruiters, trade profitably, grind the opponent out.

**Key cards / engine:** Giant Rat recruiter; Berserk Gorilla; Chiron the Mage.

**How to pilot / combo lines:**
- **`Giant Rat`** dies to Special Summon an EARTH (≤1500 ATK) from deck [CDB] — fetch a `Berserk Gorilla` (2000 ATK, but it "must attack if able" and self-destructs in face-up Defense [CDB], so keep it attacking) or another Rat to keep the chain going.
- **`Chiron the Mage`** discards to blow up a Spell/Trap — pointed removal for the control decks' backrow. **`Gigantes`** banishes an EARTH from grave for a 1900 body. `Exarion Universe` pierces.
- Still runs the Scapegoat/Metamorphosis + Chaos-lite reach; the plan is a Rat-by-Rat attrition race backed by `Trap Dustshoot` up front to strip their key card.

**Weaknesses:** `Nobleman of Crossout` blows out set Giant Rats (no float); mass removal on a wide board; lacks a single dominant threat, so a resolved TER or big Chaos beater can wall the swarm.

=== EXTRA DECK ===

**One door: `Metamorphosis` — "Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same Level as the Tributed monster" [CDB].** No `Polymerization`, no `Cyber-Stein`; `Magical Scientist` is **Forbidden** in GOAT [GF-BAN]. Tokens are legal material ("including a Sheep Token from `Scapegoat`"), Metamorphosis "cannot be activated" if no Fusion in the list matches the tributed monster's Level, and it "does not properly Summon a Fusion Monster, so you cannot use `Monster Reborn` on it afterwards" [GR].

**⚠ Level audit — every monster in this deck is Level 4 or lower. Lv1:** Sheep Token, `Sinister Serpent`, `Magician of Faith` — that is your entire native access. There is no Level 5 and no Level 6 body in the 40, and `Premature Burial`/`Call of the Haunted` only target *your* Graveyard [CDB], so `Snatch Steal` on an opposing Level 5/6 is the sole route to the other three cards.

- **`Thousand-Eyes Restrict` (Lv1) is the Extra Deck, in practice:** "the most frequent and most powerful fusion monster special summoned with Metamorphosis … it can take the opponent's best monster while locking down the field at the same time" [GF-FUS]. Goats in the opponent's End Phase [GW], convert a token on your turn, then **absorb with priority** — in GOAT rules "when a Chain or Summon has finished resolving, the turn player can activate a fast effect *or a monster's Ignition Effect* before the opponent is allowed to respond" [GF-BASICS], so equip the instant Metamorphosis resolves, before `Book of Moon` can land; if they flip it down first, TER "needs to be face up on the field to attach a monster to itself, so its effect will fizzle" [GR]. ⚠ Read the lock before you pull it: TER stops every *other* monster attacking or changing position — your whole Rat swarm included — and "monsters may not have their positions manually changed while `Thousand-Eyes Restrict` is on the field" [GR]. For a beatdown deck it is a brake: use it to survive a turn against a resolved Chaos beater, or to steal the one monster you cannot run over. Also, monsters equipped to TER "do not have effects and are treated as Equip Spell Cards" [GR], so it blanks what it steals.
- **`Ryu Senshi` (Lv6) — needs a *stolen* Level 6:** "the most commonly used level 6 fusion monster, and it [is] mostly used for setting up kill turns via Chaos Sorcerer+Metamorphosis" [GF-FUS] — but you play no Chaos Sorcerer, so the only line is `Snatch Steal` on their Level 6 (usually their own `Chaos Sorcerer`) and Metamorphosis it. Worth doing when it happens: it pays 1000 LP to negate a **Normal Trap** (`Mirror Force`, `Torrential Tribute`, `Sakuretsu Armor`, `Ring of Destruction` — *not* the Counter Trap `Solemn Judgment`) and "negate[s] the effects of any Spell Card that targets this card and destroy[s] it" [CDB], walking through `Book of Moon` and `Snatch Steal` — precisely the removal that punishes a wide EARTH board.
- **`Dark Balter the Terrible` (Lv5) — same restriction, off a stolen Level 5:** "after Thousand-Eyes Restrict, this is the most commonly used fusion monster brought forth with Metamorphosis … the potential to negate both spells and monster effects is quite powerful" [GF-FUS]; normally made off `Airknight Parshath` [GW] — theirs, not yours. It pays 1000 LP to negate a Normal Spell (`Pot of Greed`, `Graceful Charity`, `Heavy Storm`, `Nobleman of Crossout`) and negates the effect of any Effect Monster it kills in battle [CDB].
- **`Musician King` (Lv5) — ⚠ unverified line in *this* deck.** The one sourced reason to run a LIGHT Level-5 vanilla is Chaos fuel: "in the rare situations where you have `Snatch Steal` for your opponent's `Airknight Parshath` and need to Metamorphosis for a light monster in your graveyard for a chaos monster [it] could be the difference between winning and losing the game" [GF-FUS]. **This deck plays no Chaos monster at all** — no `Black Luster Soldier`, no `Chaos Sorcerer` — so that reason does not apply here, and I found no other sourced role for it. Off a stolen Level 5 it is a 1750 vanilla that `Dark Balter the Terrible` strictly outclasses. Treat it as cuttable.
